facts.business: Alkem Laboratories Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in the development, manufacturing, and marketing of pharmaceutical products including generic formulations, with operations across domestic and international markets.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) investments in specific technologies to improve environmental and social impacts
Research & Development (R&D) investments in specific technologies to improve environmental and social impacts

key_risks: Climate change leading to increased operating costs and emissions
Improper waste management leading to regulatory non-compliance and reputational damage
Water scarcity and poor water quality disrupting manufacturing operations
Human rights violations impairing stakeholder trust and damaging corporate reputation
Exposure to hazardous substances and operational risks impacting employee health and safety
Counterfeit products affecting patient safety, brand trust, revenue and market reputation
Product-quality failures or adverse health impacts resulting in penalties and loss of customer trust
Unethical or non-compliant clinical trials delaying approvals and creating legal risks
facts.related_party_note: The Company has issued corporate guarantees to its subsidiaries/step-down subsidiaries amounting to ₹18,836.6 million as on 31 March 2026 (₹17,529.3 million as on 31 March 2025). Assets pledged against loans taken by subsidiaries amount to ₹2,150.0 million as on 31 March 2026 (₹2,150.0 million as on 31 March 2025).
